children:
The web system values should only be reviewed or edited by a member 
 of your IT staff or a system consultant. The system is shipped with the 
 most common default values which should meet your business needs. Do not 
 change any of the system-defined values unless you first talk to your 
 system consultant.

Below are descriptions of the web system values. You can review and/or 
 edit the following values:

"Sent From" Address On Email 
 From Email Alert

: This value provides the email address for the 
 person who will receive return emails. When you send an email alert and 
 your recipient selects the Return/Reply Button, the value you defined 
 here will appear in the To section of the return email. Generally, the 
 email return address should be your support team's email.

"Sent from" Name On Email 
 From Email Alert

: This value identifies who sent the email alert 
 from your warehouse to your customer. The address that you define here 
 will appear in the From section of the email alert sent from your warehouse 
 to the customer.
Storage Directory For Web Order Files

: 
 This value identifies the storage directory used for web order files generated 
 by TPM.

: 
 This value indicates the directory where you want the system to place 
 your reviewed web orders. A reviewed order is an order that has been opened 
 and processed through the system's main Order Entry Window. An order is 
 moved from the Order Directory to this directory when this occurs.

: These values indicate the path of the graphic that will 
 appear at the top-left/center/right of the Trading Partner Management 
 Main Menu. The path should be in this format:\\YourServer\Directory1\Directory2\ 
 graphic.gif.

 Section

:  These

content_text:
Reviewing Web System Values...
        The web system values should only be reviewed or edited by a member 
 of your IT staff or a system consultant. The system is shipped with the 
 most common default values which should meet your business needs. Do not 
 change any of the system-defined values unless you first talk to your 
 system consultant.
         
         
         
        Related Topics...
        Trading Partner Management
        
        Initial Web Setup
        
         
         
         
        Below are descriptions of the web system values. You can review and/or 
 edit the following values:
         
        Alert System Value Descriptions...
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    Value Key
                
                
                    Value Description
                     
                
            
            
                
                    10
                
                
                    "Sent From" Address On Email 
 From Email Alert: This value provides the email address for the 
 person who will receive return emails. When you send an email alert and 
 your recipient selects the Return/Reply Button, the value you defined 
 here will appear in the To section of the return email. Generally, the 
 email return address should be your support team's email.
                     
                
            
            
                
                    20
                
                
                    "Sent from" Name On Email 
 From Email Alert: This value identifies who sent the email alert 
 from your warehouse to your customer. The address that you define here 
 will appear in the From section of the email alert sent from your warehouse 
 to the customer.
                     
                
            
        
         
         
        Web 
 Order System Value Descriptions...
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    Value Key
                
                
                    Value Description
                     
                
            
            
                
                    60
                
                
                    Storage Directory For Web Order Files: 
 This value identifies the storage directory used for web order files generated 
 by TPM.
                     
                
            
            
                
                    90
                
                
                    Reviewed Web Order Directory: 
 This value indicates the directory where you want the system to place 
 your reviewed web orders. A reviewed order is an order that has been opened 
 and processed through the system's main Order Entry Window. An order is 
 moved from the Order Directory to this directory when this occurs.
                     
                
            
        
         
         
        General 
 Web System Value Descriptions...
         
        
            
            
            
                
                    Value Key
                
                
                    Value Description
                     
                
            
            
                
                    140
                
                
                    Graphic For Left/Center/Right Header 
 Section: These values indicate the path of the graphic that will 
 appear at the top-left/center/right of the Trading Partner Management 
 Main Menu. The path should be in this format:\\YourServer\Directory1\Directory2\ 
 graphic.gif. 
                     
                
            
            
                
                    170
                
                
                    Internet Address For Center Header 
 Section:  These 
 values indicate the specific URL of the link that will be associated with 
 the graphic that appears at the top-center of the Trading Partner Management 
 Main Menu. The URL should be in this format:
                     
                    LOCAL URL: \\YourServer\Directory1\Directory2\yourPage.htm
                    REMOTE URL: http://www.manh.com.
